name: I Can't Believe It's Not Butter! Spray (Emulsifier WARNING)
searchKeywords: i cant believe its not butter spray
whyItWorks: Contains soybean oil emulsified with water, polysorbate 60, soy lecithin, artificial flavors, sodium benzoate, and calcium disodium EDTA. Synthetic food emulsifiers like polysorbate 60 have been demonstrated in peer-reviewed clinical studies to erode the colonic protective mucus layer and promote bacterial translocation.
prepOrOrderInstructions: AVOID chemical butter sprays. Choose pure clarified ghee, olive oil, or whipped real butter instead.
